name: stocksense-erp
description: StockSense ERP - Enterprise Logistics & Inventory (React + Express)

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev --workspace=frontend & npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config client/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run smoke && npm run browser
